d: The Knicks defeated the Timberwolves, 102-99 tonight in Minnesota. Karl-Anthony Towns contributed a team-high 22 points to go with 12 rebounds 4 assists and 2 three pointers, with Jalen Brunson of the Knicks adding an additional 21 points (8-20 FG, 4-5 3P) in the game. Jonathan Kuminga finished with a team-high 23 points along with 3 rebounds for the Timberwolves in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 9-6 with the win, while the Timberwolves fall to 11-5 for the season.
